verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Agent apps let teams use partner-built agents directly in their GitHub workflows on the Copilot subscription. They also say tasks can be assigned to third-party agents such as Claude and OpenAI Codex, and that multiple agents can be tracked and governed from one place. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how partner agent apps are discovered, installed and configured, which partners are available, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can integrate third-party partner-built agent apps into my workflows

citations.quote: Agent apps let you use partner-built agents directly in your workflows on GitHub, powered by your Copilot subscription.
Assign tasks to agents like Copilot, Claude by Anthropic, and OpenAI Codex, and let them plan, explore, and execute work autonomously in the background.
track progress across multiple agents, review changes, and merge completed work
enforce governance by managing agents from a single control plane
